description-zh: Python程序的入口函数示例，包含命令行参数处理和模块导入保护
description-en: Entry point function example for Python programs, including command line arguments and module import guard
code:
import sys
import argparse

def main(args=None):
    # 如果没有提供参数，使用系统参数
    if args is None:
        args = sys.argv[1:]
    
    # 创建参数解析器
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='示例Python程序')
    parser.add_argument('--name', default='World', help='要问候的名字')
    
    # 解析参数
    args = parser.parse_args(args)
    
    # 程序主要逻辑
    print(f'Hello, {args.name}!')
    
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

def url_tools(s: str, params: dict):
    enc = quote(s, safe='')
    dec = unquote(enc)
    query = urlencode(params, doseq=True)
    return enc, dec, query

description-zh: 动态规划计算两个字符串编辑距离
description-en: DP to compute edit distance between two strings
code:
def edit_distance(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    m, n = len(a), len(b)
    prev = list(range(n+1))
    cur = [0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(1, m+1):
        cur[0] = i
        ai = a[i-1]
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            cost = 0 if ai == b[j-1] else 1
            cur[j] = min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j-1] + 1, prev[j-1] + cost)
        prev, cur = cur, prev
    return prev[n]

description-en: Calculate similarity between two strings using Jaccard coefficient
code:
def string_similarity(s1: str, s2: str) -> float:
    set1 = set(s1.lower())
    set2 = set(s2.lower())
    intersection = set1 & set2
    union = set1 | set2
    return len(intersection) / len(union) if union else 1.0
